author: Deathtime153
body:
This is an appeal for two people, me and my sibling.
His username: Boboyjoe153
My username: Deathtime153

Reason I was banned: I was banned by Tynvale, a former staff member, for being accused of ban evading when I was actually trying to get my sibling, Boboyjoe153, unbanned. 

Reason he was banned: He was banned for an anti knock back glitch that he never caused when he jumped down on top of an enemy player from a bridge above the player.

Why he should be unbanned:
 He should be unbanned because when he jumped down on top of the enemy player, I was watching him play at the time because we shared an account then, the game started to glitch and we both could tell something was wrong, he knocked the player off the bridge and out of the world and into the void, and we both knew that my brother should have been knocked of two because the other player clearly had hit my brother and my brother lost health in the game as well but was never knocked back and out of the world like he should have and then all of a sudden it said he was banned for something he never did, anti knockback.

Why I should be unbanned:
I was playing on Avicus one day and I saw my brother looking over my shoulder and watching me play. (This is after my brother was banned). I then decided to try and get him unbanned so I went to the hub and asked some staff members who were on at the time,(Tynvale), and asked them to unban Boboyjoe153. We had a long discussion about it and then he said he would unban Boboyjoe153. A moment later a message appeared on my screen saying I was banned for ban evading.

replies.body: If you could find it in your hearts to unban us we both swear on our lives we won't do anything that would result in us getting kicked, banned, or tempbanned including foul language because some people are too young to know foul language. We swear not to make adds for anything and above all, we swear not to hack.
